author: GitHub
description:
How do you ship a coding agent that works smoothly across OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and whatever model drops next week? You build a harness. In this GitHub Universe 2026 session, Julia Kasper from Microsoft shares the evaluation framework the GitHub Copilot team uses to continuously test, measure, and optimize its coding agent across a matrix of clients, models, and configurations. Discover how reproducible benchmarks, thousands of autonomous coding runs, and LLM-graded assertions catch regressions before developers do. 

Speakers: 
Julia Kasper, Product Manager, Microsoft 

Watch more videos from GitHub Universe 2026: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AArI948SDz8&list=PLENrlACZ7mnU

01:04 Understanding the GitHub Copilot harness

title: How we optimize GitHub Copilot for every new model

description:
Think open source projects cannot attract serious venture funding? In this clip from The GitHub Podcast, Serena partner, Matt Lavergne, breaks down the numbers behind commercial open source. While mega-rounds pushed investments to $26 billion in a single standout year, VCs steadily invest roughly $9 billion across 250 open source deals every single year.
